# R12 Gehennom and the invocation (NetHack 5.0)

## Summary

- Gehennom is a branch of 20–24 levels including the Valley, four demon lairs/towns, the real and fake Wizard's Tower levels, Vlad's Tower branch, the vibrating-square level, and Moloch's Sanctum. Special-level order varies within documented depth ranges; do not navigate by a fixed depth script. [NetHackWiki: Gehennom](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Gehennom) (3.6-era level spoiler; inherited layout should be checked against 5.0 Lua data).
- In ordinary Gehennom, use persistent map exploration and stair tracking. The fake Wizard's Tower containing the portal must be entered by digging through its surrounding walls; teleporting into the tower itself fails. [NetHackWiki: Fake Wizard's Tower](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Fake_Wizard%27s_Towers) (3.6-era spoiler; exact 5.0 Lua map not independently re-derived).
- Vlad carries the Candelabrum; the Wizard of Yendor has the Book of the Dead on his square in the real tower. Vlad's top-floor chests are the guaranteed candle reserve (the guarantee dates to 3.6.0). [Vlad's Tower](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Vlad%27s_tower), [Book of the Dead](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/You_turn_the_pages_of_the_Book_of_the_Dead...) (3.6/3.7 spoiler lineage).
- On the vibrating square, apply a non-cursed, seven-candle Candelabrum, apply a charged non-cursed Bell of Opening, then read a non-cursed Book of the Dead. The Book must be last. [Invocation ritual](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/At_least_one_of_your_artifacts_is_cursed...) (classic mechanics; 5.0 fixes cited below).
- A 5.0-specific correction matters: Juiblex resists magical digging from inside, and the 5.0 fix list repairs Candelabrum fuel accounting. Do not use older “dig out of Juiblex” tactics. [5.0.0 fixes](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/doc/fixes5-0-0.txt#L2355-L2361).

## Bot rules

### R12.1 — Explore Gehennom without assuming a fixed special-level order

- **Trigger:** The status line's `Dlvl` changes below the Castle/Valley; the screen shows corridors, walls, stairs (`<`/`>`), pools (`}`), or lava (`}` in standard text map rendering). The exact NLE branch label is **UNVERIFIED**; retain the current branch/depth from the entry event and stair history.
- **Action:** Build/update a per-level grid from every terminal frame. Use breadth-first exploration of reachable corridors; record every `<` and `>` coordinate. Use `s` on suspicious walls/doors when no route remains; only use a digging tool (`a` + pick-axe, then direction) or `z` + digging wand as a deliberate route through diggable rock, never as a substitute for finding stairs. Maintain a graph of levels and stairs instead of assuming Asmodeus, Juiblex, Baalzebub, and Orcus occur in a fixed order.
- **Done when:** All required branches/levels have been recorded, and the bot has located the branch stair to Vlad's Tower, the real Wizard's Tower portal, and the vibrating-square level.
- **If it fails:** Re-scan map for unexplored corridor ends and secret-door candidates; search with `s` in a stationary position; use available mapping/detection only if the level and item are known to support it. Never infer special-level identity from depth alone.
- **Evidence:** [Gehennom levels/ranges](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Gehennom) (3.6-era; retained-layout assumption), [5.0 README](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/README) (Lua level data at runtime, 5.0).

### R12.2 — Avoid the false Wizard's Tower and reach the real Tower portal

- **Trigger:** The map recognizer sees the central, small enclosed tower structure on one of the two fake-tower levels; the center of the structure is not yet entered.
- **Action:** Do **not** use a level-teleport command to enter the inner tower. Select a pick-axe with `a`, answer the direction prompt toward a tower wall, and repeat until the hero is inside; alternatively select a digging wand with `z` and aim at the wall. Once inside, detect traps/portals with a charged Bell of Opening (`a` + Bell) or a wand of secret-door detection (`z` + wand; answer any direction prompt as required by the NLE port). Step onto the revealed `^` portal tile only after the destination has been detected/confirmed.
- **Done when:** Portal activation produces the level-transition/dizziness feedback and the bot is on the bottom floor of the real Wizard's Tower.
- **If it fails:** If teleport relocates the hero outside, mark teleporting into the central tower as failed and resume digging. If no portal is detected, the bot may be in the fake tower without the portal; explore the other fake-tower floor rather than looping on the same one.
- **Evidence:** [Fake Wizard's Towers](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Fake_Wizard%27s_Towers) (3.6-era spoiler; exact 5.0 Lua map UNVERIFIED), [Magic portal](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Magic_portal) (3.6/3.7 mechanic).

### R12.3 — Obtain the Book of the Dead

- **Trigger:** The bot is in the real three-level Wizard's Tower; the Wizard of Yendor (`@`-class unique, identified by look/message/name) is present or his square is known; inventory does not yet contain `Book of the Dead`.
- **Action:** Fight/disable the Wizard using the bot's normal high-threat policy; do not step away from the square after killing him. Check the tile under the Wizard and inventory; pick up the `Book of the Dead` with `,` (or the NLE pickup-all action already configured). Track all three tower levels and stairs; the Book is on the Wizard's square, not assumed to be in his inventory.
- **Done when:** Inventory text contains `Book of the Dead` and the item is confirmed non-cursed or can later be uncursed.
- **If it fails:** Search the Wizard's death tile and adjacent item piles; do not conclude the Book is lost merely because it was absent from the monster inventory.
- **Evidence:** [Book of the Dead](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/You_turn_the_pages_of_the_Book_of_the_Dead...) (3.6/3.7 spoiler lineage); 5.0 source [`src/read.c:doread()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/src/read.c#L2740-L2765) (5.0 blind-reading behavior).

### R12.4 — Obtain the Candelabrum and seven candles at Vlad's Tower

- **Trigger:** At any Gehennom level from the documented levels 9–13 range, the map shows a second up stair (`<`) in addition to the ordinary up stair; inventory lacks `Candelabrum of Invocation` or seven unattached candles.
- **Action:** Step onto the second up stair and press `<`. Follow the branch stairs to the top floor. Locate Vlad, kill/disable him, and collect the dropped `Candelabrum of Invocation`. Loot the two candle chests with the NLE's configured `#loot` command (send `#`, type `loot`, Enter; choose the direction/container as prompted); collect both wax and tallow candle stacks. Attach seven candles by `a` + select the candle stack + answer the attach-target prompt with the Candelabrum. Do **not** light the Candelabrum yet.
- **Done when:** Inventory shows the Candelabrum with seven candles attached, plus the Bell and Book acquired elsewhere.
- **If it fails:** Search all top-floor chests; the two guaranteed candle stacks are in chests, not necessarily loose on the floor. If the expected second stair is absent, keep checking all special levels in the allowed 9–13 range.
- **Evidence:** [Gehennom](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Gehennom) (Vlad stair range), [Vlad's Tower](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Vlad%27s_tower), [Light source](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Light_source) (4–8 each, 3.6.0 guarantee); 5.0 [`src/apply.c` functions `use_candle()` and `use_candelabrum()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/src/apply.c#L2189-L2193).

### R12.5 — Find and confirm the vibrating square

- **Trigger:** The bot is on the second-to-bottom Gehennom level; the map shows unexplored floor/maze squares, or a step/search produces `You feel a strange vibration under your feet.` (exact wording may vary with levitation/flying; alternate wording **UNVERIFIED**).
- **Action:** Record the coordinate at the exact message. If not found, detect traps with a charged Bell of Opening or secret-door detection, or use a confused non-cursed scroll of gold detection if available; otherwise systematically search/walk unexplored floor. When the square is known, verify the 5.0 map annotation `gateway to Moloch's Sanctum` if it appears, but do not require the annotation as the only signal.
- **Done when:** Current coordinate matches the vibration message and/or detected vibrating-square location; the tile is safely accessible and not a stair tile.
- **If it fails:** Do not invoke on a guessed coordinate. Recheck the full second-bottom level and preserve any map annotation/location knowledge after save/restore.
- **Evidence:** [Vibrating square](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Vibrating_square), [Invocation ritual](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/At_least_one_of_your_artifacts_is_cursed...), [5.0 README](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/README) (5.0 annotation; UI rendering in NLE UNVERIFIED).

### R12.6 — Perform invocation with explicit BUC and prompt control

- **Trigger:** Hero stands on the confirmed vibrating square; inventory has Candelabrum with exactly seven attached candles, charged Bell of Opening, and Book of the Dead; BUC state for each unique item is known non-cursed.
- **Action:**
  1. `a` → select `Candelabrum of Invocation` → confirm/accept only the light action. Expected message begins `The candelabrum's candles burn brightly!`.
  2. `a` → select `Bell of Opening`. This applies/rings the Bell; do not select an ordinary bell. Expected message begins `You ring the Bell of Opening. The Bell of Opening issues an unsettling shrill sound...`.
  3. Immediately `r` → select `Book of the Dead`. Do not interpose travel, combat, waiting, or another action between ringing and reading. The Book is last.
  4. Treat `You are standing at the top of a stairwell leading down!` as success. Update current tile and map to the new down stair; expect fire traps and moat around the hero, so do not move blindly.
- **Done when:** Success message is seen and the former vibrating-square tile is the new down stair to Sanctum.
- **If it fails:** `The invocation fails!` / `At least one of your artifacts is cursed...` → stop and uncurse the named/unknown unique items, verify all three. `You hear a faint chime...` → Bell missing/uncharged/ineffective; `Vlad's doppelganger is amused.` → Candelabrum absent/not properly prepared; `You have a feeling that something is amiss... You raised the dead!` → Bell effect expired or Candelabrum not lit enough; recover, re-check charges/7 candles/BUC, and retry. Do not keep reading repeatedly while unprepared.
- **Evidence:** [Invocation ritual](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/At_least_one_of_your_artifacts_is_cursed...) (messages/order); 5.0 [`src/apply.c:use_bell()`, `use_candelabrum()`, `use_candle()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/src/apply.c); 5.0 [`src/read.c:doread()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/src/read.c#L2740-L2765); [5.0 fixes](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/doc/fixes5-0-0.txt#L2355-L2361).

### R12.7 — Enter Sanctum, find the temple, kill the High Priest

- **Trigger:** Invocation success; new down stair under hero; screen shows dark corridors, graves/monsters, no map reveal; inventory contains invocation items.
- **Action:** Descend with `>`; use a light source. Do not use magic mapping, teleport, or digging as a navigation strategy on this level. Find the inner temple's secret door: use a charged Bell of Opening (`a` + Bell) against candidate wall/door areas or a wand of secret-door detection; otherwise search walls with `s` while adjacent. Enter only after the door opens; require the exact hostility message `Infidel, you have entered Moloch's Sanctum! Be gone!` before attacking the High Priest. Kill/disable him and immediately pick up the real Amulet with `,`.
- **Done when:** Inventory has the Amulet of Yendor; rename/flag it as real in bot state; do not leave it on the ground.
- **If it fails:** If the High Priest remains peaceful, the bot has not crossed into the temple; do not attack him from outside. If the map seems blocked, search all four temple wall segments; mapping/teleport/digging will not solve the Sanctum map.
- **Evidence:** [Moloch's Sanctum](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Moloch%27s_Sanctum) (map, door, hostility message; 3.6-era spoiler); 5.0 [`src/pray.c:offer_real_amulet()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/src/pray.c#L2197-L2202) (real Amulet offer handler).

### R12.8 — Ascend through Gehennom with the Amulet

- **Trigger:** Inventory contains the real Amulet; hero is on a Gehennom level with an up stair `<`.
- **Action:** Move to the stair and press `<`. Persist the level/stair graph because the mysterious force may prevent the level ascent or push the hero back. On `A mysterious force momentarily surrounds you...`, record the new `Dlvl` and map position; re-plan from that level rather than repeating a hard-coded stair path. Continue until Castle/Valley/Main Dungeon is reached; don't assume a fixed number of climbs.
- **Done when:** Status/depth and transition messages show the hero has left Gehennom and is ascending toward dungeon level 1.
- **If it fails:** If the force repeatedly blocks progress, use the observed current 5.0 state and keep re-exploring/using recorded stairs. Do not code the 3.6 fixed 1-in-4 chance or old neutral pushback average: the 3.7 rule changed the odds based on accumulated pushback and exact current formula is **UNVERIFIED**.
- **Evidence:** [Mysterious force](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Mysterious_force) (3.6 base plus 3.7 change note; exact 5.0 stair-pushback formula **UNVERIFIED**).

## Risks and exceptions

- **There is no defensible 5.0 death-frequency ranking in the sources consulted.** “Most often” cannot be answered statistically without a 5.0 dumplog corpus. The following are the highest-impact, well-documented failure modes, not a measured ranking.
- **Orcus:** treat a visible Orcus as a lethal ranged/spell threat. A death ray is an instant-death threat without reflection or magic resistance; reflection does not stop his touch-of-death spell. Prioritize line-of-fire control and a plan to disable/kill him quickly. [Orcus](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Orcus) (3.6/3.7 wiki profile; 5.0 exact numbers UNVERIFIED).
- **Asmodeus:** cold damage is the main obvious resist-check; cold resistance is a high-priority preparation. A neutral hero should not assume a lawful-bribe interaction; exact 5.0 dialogue branch for neutral Valkyrie is **UNVERIFIED**. [Asmodeus](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Asmodeus) (3.6/3.7 profile).
- **Baalzebub:** poison and stunning gaze can disrupt a turn-based controller; blindness blocks gaze tactics in the documented profile, poison resistance blocks poison. [Baalzebub](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Baalzebub) (3.6/3.7 profile).
- **Juiblex:** engulf/sickness plus possible water exposure is dangerous; carry a sickness cure/appropriate resistance and a drowning escape. **Do not** trust old advice to wand-dig him from inside: 5.0 explicitly fixed that. [Juiblex](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Juiblex), [5.0 fixes](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/doc/fixes5-0-0.txt#L2355-L2356).
- **Vlad and vampires:** level drain can compound over several attacks; drain resistance and fast damage reduce exposure. [Vlad's Tower](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Vlad%27s_tower) (3.6/3.7 strategy profile).
- **Lava and thermal terrain:** in 3.7 Gehennom, hot floors can boil/destroy dropped potions and lava rivers create route hazards. Keep levitation/flight or another safe lava crossing; do not leave critical consumables on hot floors. [Gehennom](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Gehennom) (3.7 change notes).
- **Invocation timing/BUC:** cursed items, an uncharged Bell, too few candles, or waiting too long after ringing can cause failure or raise the dead. Stage items beforehand and read the Book immediately after the Bell. [Invocation ritual](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/At_least_one_of_your_artifacts_is_cursed...), 5.0 [candle-fuel fix](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/doc/fixes5-0-0.txt#L2357-L2361).
- **Sanctum:** fire traps ring the temple; a false attack on the still-peaceful High Priest before entering the temple incurs murder. Do not try to convert the high altar. [Moloch's Sanctum](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Moloch%27s_Sanctum) (3.6-era spoiler; exact 5.0 map details medium confidence).
